prompt:
Write a police officer's crash report narrative (about 150 words). Collision type: side impact at intersection in Baytown, Texas. The claimant was a driver and reported back strain. Refer to people as Driver 1, Driver 2 or Passenger. No names, no dates. (Internal reference C-1447; do not mention it.) Work these facts into the text naturally, in your own words, without listing them:
- The reported injury matches the kind and force of the crash well.
- Witnesses, photos and the other driver all confirm the accident happened as described.
- The damage is mostly in line with the described impact.
- The police and witnesses confirm the claimant was in the vehicle.
- No earlier damage to the vehicle is known.
- The driver is named on the policy.
text: At an intersection in Baytown, Texas, Driver 1 and Driver 2 were involved in a side-impact collision. Driver 1 was traveling through the intersection when Driver 2's vehicle entered from the cross street and struck the driver's side of Driver 1's vehicle. Driver 2 confirmed at the scene that the collision happened as Driver 1 described it. Two independent witnesses gave statements consistent with both drivers, and photographs taken at the scene show damage concentrated on the driver's side, which is consistent with the reported impact. Passenger was seated in the front passenger seat, and both the responding officer and the witnesses confirmed that Passenger was present in the vehicle at the time. Driver 1 reported lower back pain and stiffness shortly after the collision. The injury appears consistent with the type and force of the impact. No prior damage to Driver 1's vehicle was observed or reported. Driver 1 was shown as the named insured on the policy documents provided at the scene. No citations were issued at the time of the report.
